name: kubernetes-the-hard-way
description: Bootstrap Kubernetes the hard way. No scripts.
one_liner: A free, step-by-step written tutorial that teaches you to build a Kubernetes cluster manually, by hand, so you understand every piece.
buyer: No direct buyer — it's a free educational tutorial, explicitly not meant for production or resale.
business_use_cases: A platform engineer follows it once to deeply understand Kubernetes internals before running a managed cluster in production.
A training company references its structure as inspiration for their own paid Kubernetes course.
A job candidate works through it to prepare for a Kubernetes-heavy technical interview.

money_ideas.idea: None directly — the author explicitly licenses it non-commercially; any money is in teaching around it, not reselling it.

steal_this: Not a product opportunity — it's a well-known, free learning resource with an explicit non-commercial license.
